outputs.headline: False: Hot water with lemon does not destroy coronavirus
outputs.summary: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy the coronavirus or cure COVID-19.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
outputs.what_is_true: Health organizations state that this is a widely circulated piece of misinformation, and there is no scientific evidence to support this claim.
evidence_against: Snopes.com rated the claim that hot water with lemons cures or prevents COVID-19 as false.
AP News also rated as false the claim that hot water, lemon, and baking soda cure coronavirus.
FactCheck.org states there is no scientific evidence that lemon juice or hot water can kill the coronavirus.
